sender.quote: Turning biological data into actionable insight.

sections.title: Motivation
sections.content: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Bioinformatics Research Engineer position at Genomics Insight GmbH. With a background spanning biotechnology, bioinformatics, computational biology, and software development, I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to a team building robust analytical solutions for real-world biological data.

sections.title: Relevant Experience
content: During my academic and research work, I have developed hands-on experience in omics data analysis, microbial genomics, transcriptomics, and computational pipeline development. My Master's work has involved omics-based analysis, gene profiling, functional interpretation, and data-driven biological reasoning.

In parallel, I have built practical skills in Python, R, Linux, automation, web technologies, and containerized workflows. This combination allows me to bridge research questions and production-ready computational implementation.

sections.title: Technical Fit
content: My technical toolkit includes Python, R, Bash, Docker, Git, CI/CD, data visualization, machine learning, and a broad set of bioinformatics tools across genomics, transcriptomics, metagenomics, and structural bioinformatics.
I am especially motivated by roles where interdisciplinary thinking, scientific rigor, and engineering reliability must come together.

sections.title: Closing Remarks
sections.content: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my research background, computational skills, and motivation to contribute can support your team's goals. Thank you for your time and consideration.
